description: This file defines the ShippingProduct class, which models a product in a shipping context, including its quantity and associated Product object.

classes.name: ShippingProduct
classes.description: A class representing a product in the shipping module with properties for product details and quantity.

methods.name: ShippingProduct
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShippingProduct with a Product object.

methods.name: getQuantity

methods.description: Sets the Product associated with this ShippingProduct.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the Product associated with this ShippingProduct.
